y0: The disciples who forgot the bread
y1: When the disciples crossed over to the other side in a boat, they forgot to take bread. When Jesus said, 'Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees,' the disciples thought it was about bread.
y2: Jesus reminded them of how He fed the five thousand and the four thousand. The yeast was the false teaching of the Pharisees. If we have Jesus, we don't need to worry about bread.
y4: Jesus asked, 'Who do people say I am?' The disciples answered, 'They say John the Baptist, Elijah, or Jeremiah.' 'But who do you say I am?'
y5: Peter answered, 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.' Jesus was happy: 'My Father in heaven revealed this to you. I will build My church on this rock.'
y7: From that time, Jesus began to tell them that He would suffer in Jerusalem, be killed, and rise on the third day.
y8: Peter took Jesus aside and said, 'May this never happen to You!' Jesus said, 'You are not thinking about the things of God, but the things of men.'
y10: Jesus said, 'If anyone wants to come after Me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.'
y11: 'What good will it be for a person if he gains the whole world, yet loses his life?' Following Jesus is the most precious way.
verse: “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
prayer: Jesus, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God. I love You, who suffered and rose again for me. Let me think not about the things of men, but the things of God, and follow You by taking up my cross. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: yeast. It is what makes bread rise. Here it means a bad teaching that spreads little by little. Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees.
d1: Christ. It means 'Anointed King'. It is the Savior sent by God. You are the Christ.
d2: rock. It is a very big and hard stone. I will build My church on this rock.
d3: church. It is a gathering of people who believe in Jesus. It is not a building, but people. Jesus builds His church.
d4: cross. It is the wooden tool of execution where Jesus died for us. Take up your cross and follow Me.
d5: life. It is the life that keeps a person alive. Life is more precious than the whole world.
